Allocation weight rules

Weights and assumptions: Hoki uses 1980 model landings proportions, transferred to regional catch years. Other split labels use model biomass proportions because source catches are incomplete; composition and catchability are assumed constant across years and catch bases.  Weights and evidence
Each percentage is the independent simple-chain PPR associated with taxa using that rule.

Unresolved taxa: none. The 121 Very low decisions account for 16.8066% of landings and 60.2188% of simple-chain PPR. Dosidicus gigas alone contributes 38.8770% of simple-chain PPR. Full mapping coverage does not establish ecological validity. Residual fish candidate sets and their reporting limits are retained in the evidence.  Reporting scope evidence
